reviewer.actual_model: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5, as supplied by the harness)
reviewer.mode: Rate (blind, independent); Impeccable Operate-mode lens: task clarity, responsive hierarchy, familiar controls, precision

rubric.total: sum(weight*score) with Decimal weights, exact; rounded Decimal(str(x)).quantize(Decimal("0.1"), ROUND_HALF_UP)
rubric.ky_fit: separate; five equal dimensions (0.20) palette_tokens/type_geometry/shell/accent_discipline/suite_cohesion; N/A excluded from mean; never pooled into quality
rubric.overall: mean of rubric-rounded per-file totals over 36 current files; unrounded-vector mean reported separately
rubric.progression_rule: Opus current-round overall quality mean, half-up to 1 decimal; >= 8.0 qualifies

evidence.capture_conditions: per review-inputs-v1.json: 1280x900 and 390x844, DPR 1, OS light/dark, en-US, America/New_York, initial viewport, no saved kydns-theme

input_verification.matrix: 9 surfaces x 2 devices x 2 themes = 36 unique combinations; desktop 1280x900, mobile 390x844

observations.coherence: Four stacked bordered cards plus a monospace key/value table at the fold restate the same counters in two data vocabularies.

observations.hierarchy: 'Dashboard' title, then a five-figure KPI strip (24 Queries, 6 Blocked, 0%, 0ms, Uptime) reads first; the four equal-weight bordered panels below give no further ranking.
observations.typography: 32px stat numerals over 13px labels; axis ticks and the Metric/Value rows ('Answered locally', 'Forwarded') are set in monospace although they are prose labels.
observations.visible_affordances: The selected 'Dashboard' nav row has a soft fill and orange left rail and the outlined 'Sign out' sits at the sidebar bottom; the charts show no visible controls.

satisfaction_reasons: Overall quality mean of rounded per-file totals is 6.47(2) -> 6.5, below the 8.0 progression line.
At 390px, the Services, Records, Blacklists and Settings captures clip tables or fieldsets at the card edge, and row actions are off-canvas.
The Discovered mobile header stretches to ~330px with a blank band, a shell layout break.
Accent discipline: Services shows four filled accent buttons and Blacklists styles 'Turn filtering off' as primary and tints decorative pills.
Settings nests fieldset frames inside a card with uneven masonry gaps and no visible save action.
Appearance (8.0) and Login (7.9) are near target; the admin-console cohort (n=24) carries the deficit.
scope: Visual progression evidence only; not behaviour, security, integration, production or 9/10 acceptance.
